استطلعوا (form X)
# اِسْتَطْلَعُوا (istaṭlaʕū) /is.tatˤ.la.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
# اُسْتُطْلِعُوا (ustuṭliʕū) /us.tutˤ.li.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
# اِسْتَطْلِعُوا (istaṭliʕū) /is.tatˤ.li.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَطْلَعَ (istaṭlaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
